meaning: Compile an explicit GREEN revision, verify the install artifact, upload it to Google Drive Source of Truth, record hash/provenance, and expose the exact Drive install link inside LuHm OS.
never_means: debug signer labeled as production signer
install_link_rule: The app must consume the exact Source-of-Truth file URL/ID returned after upload; never synthesize a Drive URL from a filename.
production_gate: Persistent luhmos-release signer remains required before a production Android artifact can be labeled GREEN.
